headlines.title: It’s cute. It’s cuddly. And it wants all your data.
headlines.description: Meta is touting its new personal AI agent, Muse, as a product “built for everyone” — including those who lack experience with technology.

headlines.title: Bond yields surge to fresh two-decade highs, but oil prices are buffeted by Iran headlines
headlines.description: The monthlong rise in Treasury bond yields has already translated into higher borrowing costs for consumers, especially in the mortgage market.

headlines.title: Map: See how gas prices have changed in the county where you live
headlines.description: How much gas prices have increased during the Iran war depends entirely on where you live, an NBC News analysis of average gas price data from AAA shows.

headlines.title: McDonald’s leans into AI and new menu items to attract customers
headlines.description: McDonald’s plans to invest $8.5 billion in its new “NEXT" strategy using AI technology to modernize restaurants and introducing new menu items to reach more customers. NBC News’ Allie Canal breaks down what the company’s next chapter could look like.

headlines.title: Early Deals on Holiday Shopping: What to Buy, Trends to Look For
headlines.description: With Christmas three months away, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to talk about why you should start your holiday shopping now, lists October shopping events, explains what items are worth waiting for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, the gift trends to watch for, and more!

headlines.title: How to Navigate the Housing Market Amid Rising Interest Rates
headlines.description: The housing market is always changing, so real estate broker and president of R New York Stefani Berkin joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to separate fact from myth. See her expert breakdown, which includes the best time to buy a home, when to do repairs, and more.

headlines.title: Carla A. Harris Shares Career Advice, Talks AI and Jobs
headlines.description: Author and senior advisor at Morgan Stanley, Carla A. Harris joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share some advice to be successful in your career. She shares tips for getting noticed by your manager, and reacts to concerns about the job market with the increasing presence of AI. “I think this is one of the most exciting times for anybody in their career because all the rule books are being re-written…It’s not the time to be dictated to, it's the time to design,” she

headlines.title: The U.S. economy before and after the Iran war, in five charts
headlines.description: Nearly seven months in, the conflict now casts a cloud of uncertainty — with no end in sight.

headlines.title: American dream of owning a home out of reach for many as mortgage rates soar (again)
headlines.description: Interest rates on a 30-year fixed mortgage soared to 7.2%. Coupled with near record high prices, it’s putting homeownership out of reach for millions.

headlines.title: Trump rolls out red carpets for Xi, though he has portrayed China as a global menace
headlines.description: Just two months ago, President Donald Trump gave a primetime speech accusing China of interfering in the 2020 election.

headlines.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico allowed back at the White House after judge blocked Trump’s ban
headlines.description: In granting a temporary restraining order while the news outlets’ legal challenge proceeds, the judge said that Trump’s ban was likely unconstitutional.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.
